finding.title: The use of `reinterpret_cast` to access memory at arbitrary addresses can lead to undefined behavior, buffer overflows, or other security vulnerabilities.
The code does not check if the provided address is within the valid range of PPU registers, which can lead to buffer overflows.

scan_orig.message: Check buffer boundaries if used in a loop including recursive loops (CWE-120, CWE-20).

scan_patch.message: Check buffer boundaries if used in a loop including recursive loops (CWE-120, CWE-20).
